Meeting Date:                 4/27/2022
Sponsor(s):                   Rodriguez Sanchez (33)
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 7-1 at 2621 W Belmont Ave
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                       ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all ofthe RM-5,
Residential Multi-Unit District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 7-1 in the
area bound by:

      West Belmont Avenue; a line 376 feet east ofand parallel to North Washtenaw Avenue;
      the alley next south of and parallel to West Belmont Avenue; and a line 351 feet east of
      and parallel to North Washtenaw Avenue,

to those of a Ml-2 Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                          Rossana Rodriguez Sanchez
                                                          Alderman, 33'" Ward




Common Address:
2621 W. Belmont Avenue
